source_scope_read_before_freeze: qualitative statement that safety improves while capability is largely preserved

predictions.financial_safety: FiRSD lowers FinHarmBench attack success rate for every model.
predictions.general_safety: FiRSD does not increase HarmBench attack success rate by more than five percentage points for any model.
predictions.benign_helpfulness: FiRSD reduces benign-request accuracy by no more than five percentage points for each model.
predictions.external_capability: For each model, the post-FiRSD mean across FiQA-SA, Headlines, MMLU, and GSM8K retains at least 95 percent of the corresponding pre-FiRSD mean.

decision_rule.accept: All four predictions hold for a model.
decision_rule.reject: Financial safety does not improve or either safety guardrail is violated.
decision_rule.abstain: Financial safety improves and the safety guardrails hold, but external capability retention falls below 95 percent.

scoring.independence_guardrail: The three models are nested within one source and are not independent studies.
